response.sql: WITH name_totals AS (SELECT ra.name AS name, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY ra.name), avg_total AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_points FROM name_totals), top_names AS (SELECT nt.name, nt.total_points FROM name_totals nt, avg_total a WHERE nt.total_points > a.avg_points) SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM top_names) AS combined_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId WHERE ra.name IN (SELECT name FROM top_names)) AS avg_laps_completed, (SELECT AVG(tn.total_points - a.avg_points) FROM top_names tn, avg_total a) AS avg_excess_over_average_total;
